explication: Lefthook is a Go-based Git hooks manager: developers configure hook jobs, install Git hook scripts, and Git-triggered or manually requested hooks run filtered commands and report results. Configuration supports local and remote files; installation also includes AI-assistant-specific hooks, and self-update is a separate CLI capability. The graph follows the principal CLI-to-hook workflow and key internals. Unsampled subsystem links are omitted unless documented in the README or supported by the source index.
